query: Consider the Non-Disclosure Agreement between CEII and NDA; Does the document indicate that the Agreement does not grant the Receiving Party any rights to the Confidential Information?
gold: Neither this Agreement, nor the disclosure of CEII hereunder, shall be construed in any way as granting any license or rights to any information or data now or hereafter owned or controlled by Disclosing Parties to Receiving Party and all such Confidential Information/CEII shall remain the property of Disclosing Parties.
rag_answer: Yes. Section 11 of the Agreement states that neither the Agreement nor the disclosure of CEII shall be construed as granting any license or rights to any information or data owned or controlled by the Disclosing Parties to the Receiving Party, and that all Confidential Information/CEII remains the property of the Disclosing Parties.

judge.gold_summary: 协议及 CEII 的披露不授予接收方任何许可或权利，相关保密信息/CEII 仍归披露方所有。
judge.answer_summary: 回答指出协议及 CEII 披露不授予接收方任何许可或权利，且保密信息/CEII 仍为披露方财产。
judge.reason: 系统回答覆盖了金标的关键结论，即不授予任何权利且信息仍归披露方所有；额外提及 Section 11 不构成矛盾。
